title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep — Maya + Ethan (API/Console/Dedicated/Private)
content:
Meeting: weekly PM↔Eng 1:1 (Ethan Morales)
Date: 2026-03-04 (prep notes)
Duration: 30m
Location: Zoom

Purpose / context:
- Quick sync on near-term rollouts across Hosted API + Console, Dedicated autoscale issues, and the Private deployment onboarding for PharmaCo.
- Surface blockers that need engineering attention or prioritization shifts.
- Align on capacity forecasts for next quarter and SLO adjustments.

Top agenda (30m):
1) API perf status (7m)
   - Quick ask: latest P95/P99 token latency numbers for text-gen (1k token traces). Do we still see regressions during 99th-percentile bursts?
   - Data I have: INF-2345 shows a 10% P95 increase on night-of-2/24 after kernel change. Need ETA on rollback or mitigations.
   - Question: Do we want a canary rollback for the kernel selection change or keep investigating live?

2) Console rollout + rollout UI (8m)
   - Prod rollout for canary UI scheduled 3/10. Console team flagged inconsistent feature flags across Dedicated clusters.
   - Risk: customers on Dedicated might not see rollout controls; bad UX for sales demos.
   - Ask Ethan: can platform team add a temporary cluster-level override? If yes, what's the risk window?
   - Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/482 (need review status)

3) Dedicated autoscaling bug (6m)
   - DED-112: observed thrashing when scaling down GPUs during low-load periods (sine-ish pattern). Causes failed pod evictions and job restarts.
   - Customer impact: two Dedicated tenants reported increased 5xx for 30–40m.
   - My proposal: pause aggressive downscale for low-util clusters until eviction fix merged. Need Eng sign-off to change autoscale policy config.

4) Private deployment — PharmaCo onboarding (5m)
   - Timeline: on-prem install window 3/18–3/22. We need a stable image with KMS config docs and audit logging enabled.
   - Blocker: SAML integration testing still failing (SAML-qa env). Who owns debugging? Ask SRE or private-deployments eng lead?

5) Misc / career / team health (4m)
   - Quick check-in on team pacing (are infra churn bursts causing low morale?).
   - FYI: hiring update — two backend candidates next week.

Notes-to-self / talking points:
- Be concrete with prioritization: "If we pause the kernel change canary, we can save ~X% P95 immediately; tradeoff: delayed perf gains for big request types."
- For Dedicated autoscale: we should present a rollback plan + short-term config guardrails to CS so they can message customers.
- Ask Ethan about schedule availability for a 1-hr deep dive next Tue on kernel selection + batching heuristics.
- Confirm who will own the SAML test fix — ping @sre (Slack link above) after the 1:1 if Ethan delegates.

Open blockers I want his help on:
- INF-2345 regression: need decision (investigate vs rollback). If he says rollback, ask for timeframe + who will run it.
- DED-112 autoscale thrash: request a config change ASAP and a patch release schedule.
- Private SAML test failure: need owner and target fix date (before 3/12 to give QA buffer).

Quick metrics snapshot to reference in convo:
- Hosted API (last 7d): P95 = 220ms (baseline 200ms), P99 = 610ms (baseline 600ms) — slight drift concentrated in one region.
- Dedicated: avg GPU utilization 62% (peaks 86% during batch jobs); one cluster reported 95% CPU steal on 2/25 (possible node-level noisy neighbor).
- Private onboarding: current checklist 18/22 items green, 4 items blocked (SAML, KMS test vector, audit log rotation, release image signing).

Draft asks / decisions needed by end of week:
- Decision on INF-2345 (rollback vs continue): owner = Ethan (expected answer by 2026-03-06)
- Autoscale policy temporary adjustment: owner = Eng infra (Ethan to assign; target 2026-03-05)
- SAML fix owner + ETA: owner = SRE or private-deployments (Ethan to confirm)

Action items (post-meeting follow-ups):
- [Maya] If Ethan approves rollback, open an ops runbook + notify CS + update deployment calendar (due 2026-03-06).
- [Ethan] Assign engineer to DED-112 and confirm temporary policy change (due 2026-03-05).
- [Ethan] Confirm SAML owner for PharmaCo and set target fix (due 2026-03-05).
- [Maya] Draft customer-facing note for Dedicated tenants affected by autoscale thrash (to share with CS once we have a mitigations plan) (due 2026-03-06).
- [Ethan] Allocate 1-hr kernel+batching deep dive next Tue; invite L2 infra and applied-ml folks (due 2026-03-09).

Post-meeting quick checklist (how I'll follow up):
- Copy decisions into INF-2345 and DED-112 with owners + due dates.
- Post summary in #product-eng-1on1 and ping CS and SRE threads.
- Update roadmap board if we shift timeline for canary rollout.

Draft follow-up message to send after meeting:
"Thanks Ethan — per our 1:1: we've agreed to (1) X, (2) Y, (3) Z. I've created INF-2345-note and assigned rollback runbook to ops if you choose rollback. I'll draft the customer note for Dedicated tenants and tag CS for review. Please confirm the SAML owner and ETA by EOD Fri so we can keep the PharmaCo window. — Maya"

Random scratch / notes-to-self (voicey):
- Might push kernel change to smaller model shard first (low-risk path) if rollback not desired.
- Remember to ask about long-term capacity forecasting model — do we need to bump reserved GPU commitments next quarter?

End.
